patterns.note: Full-bleed, distinct content sections with a strong horizontal rhythm, often featuring large, numbered titles and asymmetric arrangements of text and imagery.
Extreme contrast in type scale, pairing very large, bold, often uppercase sans-serif headings with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text and a distinct, narrow sans-serif for metadata.
A stark, high-contrast black and white base palette, with vibrant, rich colors introduced primarily through full-bleed photography and video content within project showcases.
Major content sections and their internal elements reveal with a staggered slide-in or fade-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a dynamic, chapter-like progression.
Each primary content section is introduced by a large, sequential number (e.g., '1 Studio Dado', '2 The Lookback') acting as a visual anchor and organizing principle.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header and footer that remain visible throughout the scroll. Content sections are designed as full-bleed blocks that animate into view using scroll-triggered reveals, where elements within each section (text, images) slide or fade in with a slight delay as the section becomes visible. The hero features an auto-playing background video.

The visual design relies on a high-contrast black background with white text, using large, bold sans-serif typography for headings to establish a strong visual hierarchy. Project showcases integrate full-bleed imagery and video, often with a minimal text overlay or adjacent text block, to introduce color and detail.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, often uppercase headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, regular-weight body text and a distinct, narrow sans-serif for metadata, creating extreme contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous negative space around large headings and between major content sections, contributing to an editorial feel.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, full-screen scroll-triggered reveals that make each project feel like a distinct, immersive chapter. The combination of extreme typographic scale, stark black-and-white aesthetic, and generous negative space elevates the portfolio beyond a typical showcase into a high-end, editorial experience.
